conf.description: z/OS ACF2/Top Secret security-admin-changes, syslog-raw: parses ACF2 ACFRPTLL/ACFRPTRL header-line summaries (pipe-delimited unload) and Top Secret EARLOUT MD fixed positions. Per-field OLD/NEW VALUE detail (ACFRPTLL DETAIL's indented line group) is NOT reassembled - no verified conf shape exists in this catalog for a stateful multi-line join (same reasoning as this catalog's netapp-ontap management-audit precedent) - documented as a gap rather than guessed.

conf.comment: security-admin-changes / syslog-raw. ACF2: pipe-delimited unload, two header-line sub-grammars (ACFRPTLL logonid changes, 12 tokens incl. LOGONID+USING; ACFRPTRL rule changes, 10 tokens incl. RULE-ID, no LOGONID/USING) discriminated by field count - unverified against a sample. Top Secret: fixed EARLOUT positions per the work order (ACID NAME 14-21, RETURN CODE 82-83); MD RECORD DATA's start offset is NOT given, only 'up to 256 bytes', so it's inferred as everything after RETURN CODE and capped at 256 chars - flagged, not asserted. ACFRPTLL DETAIL's indented per-field OLD VALUE/NEW VALUE lines are a separate multi-line group this pipeline does not reassemble (no whitelisted function has a verified conf for that join) - FIELD/OLD VALUE/NEW VALUE/masking are a documented gap, not a guess. See README.

functions.description: Message body: a Cribl Syslog Source leaves the full line, header included, in _raw and the body in message; anything else carries the body in _raw.
Top Secret EARLOUT MD branch: ACID NAME and RETURN CODE at their documented byte positions; MD RECORD DATA's start offset is inferred (see comment above).
ACFRPTLL branch (logonid maintenance): record descriptor + DATE/TIME + LOGONID + NAME + CHANGER + CHANGER NAME + CHANGE + JOBNAME + CPU + USING + SIGNAL.
ACFRPTRL branch (rule maintenance): record descriptor + DATE/TIME + RULE-ID + CHANGER + CHANGER NAME + CHANGE + JOBNAME + CPU + SIGNAL (no LOGONID/USING).
Merge the ACFRPTLL/ACFRPTRL shared columns onto one field name each.

user.name strips the '@' elevated-authority prefix off CHANGER, or falls back to the Top Secret ACID NAME (which never carries the prefix); acf2.elevated_change lifts that prefix into an explicit boolean; event.action normalizes CHANGE; tss.admin.command truncates the inferred MD RECORD DATA capture to its documented 256-byte cap; event.outcome is 'success' for ACF2 (the reports only record applied changes - absence of an outcome column is not absence of an outcome, per recommendations.direct.cribl) and taken from the Top Secret return code otherwise. Computed before the rename step below, straight off the raw column names, since rename would otherwise retarget LOGONID/RULEID first.
Fallback event time - same LPAR-offset/Julian-date gap as the other two datasets; no CPU/SYSID timezone lookup was supplied.
Tag event.category from the dataset's own event_categories; event.dataset set to the data stream's own dataset component (logs-zos_acf2.admin_changes).
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
